_rule: The storyboard draws its own pictures before any video is made: 8 pictures at 60 s, 24 at 2 minutes, then about one more picture per 5 s of runtime, capped at storyboard_picture_cap. This count is separate from - and larger than - the video shot count (catalog_calculator.video_shot_count); the two are never conflated.
_authority: The cap lives HERE, in configuration. catalog_calculator.shot_count reads it on every call and never hard-codes a picture maximum.
